metadata.question: Was there more soil moisture in regions near Beledweyne, Somalia in May 2018 compared to the same time last year?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: We need soil moisture data. SMAP L3 (10–36 km) is the go-to for near-surface moisture. Beledweyne lies ~4.7°N 45.2°E. Collection: NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP_E/006 (daily composite, 10–36 km, units: m³/m³). Periods: 1–31 May 2018 vs 1–31 May 2017. 2. Masking: The official QA flag (retrieval_qual_flag) = 0 means best quality; mask anything ≠ 0. 3. Logic: - Pull each month, apply QA mask, spatial mean inside a 50 km buffer around the town. - If either collection is empty → C1. - After QA masking, if valid-pixel count = 0 for either month → C2. - If computed mean is None/NaN → C3. - Otherwise, if 2018 mean > 2017 mean → A, else B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time pt = ee.Geometry.Point([45.2, 4.7]) # Beledweyne roi = pt.buffer(50000) # 50 km buffer may2017 = ee.DateRange('2017-05-01', '2017-05-31') may2018 = ee.DateRange('2018-05-01', '2018-05-31') # 2. Data acquisition & check def get_moisture(dr): col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP_E/006') .filterDate(dr) .filterBounds(roi)) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: return None, 0 masked = col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('retrieval_qual_flag').eq(0))) img = masked.mean().select('soil_moisture') count = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=roi, scale=36000, maxPixels=1e9)\ .get('soil_moisture').getInfo() mean = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry=roi, scale=36000, maxPixels=1e9)\ .get('soil_moisture').getInfo() return mean, count mean17, cnt17 = get_moisture(may2017) mean18, cnt18 = get_moisture(may2018) print(f"2017 mean: {mean17} m³/m³, valid pixels: {cnt17}") print(f"2018 mean: {mean18} m³/m³, valid pixels: {cnt18}") # 3. Validation & answer if mean17 is None or mean18 is None: print("C1") elif cnt17 == 0 or cnt18 == 0: print("C2") elif mean18 is None or mean17 is None or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(mean18) or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(mean17): print("C3") elif mean18 > mean17: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
pt = ee.Geometry.Point([45.2, 4.7])           # Beledweyne
roi = pt.buffer(50000)                        # 50 km buffer
may2017 = ee.DateRange('2017-05-01', '2017-05-31')
may2018 = ee.DateRange('2018-05-01', '2018-05-31')

# 2. Data acquisition & check
def get_moisture(dr):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/SMAP/SPL3SMP_E/006')
             .filterDate(dr)
             .filterBounds(roi))
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        return None, 0
    masked = col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('retrieval_qual_flag').eq(0)))
    img = masked.mean().select('soil_moisture')
    count = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                             geometry=roi, scale=36000, maxPixels=1e9)\
                .get('soil_moisture').getInfo()
    mean = img.reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
                            geometry=roi, scale=36000, maxPixels=1e9)\
               .get('soil_moisture').getInfo()
    return mean, count

mean17, cnt17 = get_moisture(may2017)
mean18, cnt18 = get_moisture(may2018)

print(f"2017 mean: {mean17} m³/m³, valid pixels: {cnt17}")
print(f"2018 mean: {mean18} m³/m³, valid pixels: {cnt18}")

# 3. Validation & answer
if mean17 is None or mean18 is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif cnt17 == 0 or cnt18 == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")
elif mean18 is None or mean17 is None or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(mean18) or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(mean17):
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif mean18 > mean17:
    print("<answer>A</answer>")
else:
    print("<answer>B</answer>")
